sysctl_rel_body.accept_dad: Whether to accept DAD (Duplicate Address Detection). 0: Disable DAD 1: Enable DAD (default) 2: Enable DAD, and disable IPv6 operation if MAC-based duplicate link-local address has been found. DAD operation and mode on a given interface will be selected according to the maximum value of conf/{all,interface}/accept_dad.
sysctl_rel_body.app_solicit: The maximum number of probes to send to the user space ARP daemon via netlink before dropping back to multicast probes (see mcast_resolicit). Defaults to 0.
sysctl_rel_body.dad_transmits: The amount of Duplicate Address Detection probes to send. Default: 1
sysctl_rel_body.enhanced_dad: Include a nonce option in the IPv6 neighbor solicitation messages used for duplicate address detection per RFC7527. A received DAD NS will only signal a duplicate address if the nonce is different. This avoids any false detection of duplicates due to loopback of the NS messages that we send. The nonce option will be sent on an interface unless both of conf/{all,interface}/enhanced_dad are set to FALSE. Default: TRUE icmp/*:
sysctl_rel_body.mcast_solicit: The maximum number of multicast probes in INCOMPLETE state, when the associated hardware address is unknown. Defaults to 3.
sysctl_rel_body.optimistic_dad: Whether to perform Optimistic Duplicate Address Detection (RFC 4429). 0: disabled (default) 1: enabled Optimistic Duplicate Address Detection for the interface will be enabled if at least one of conf/{all,interface}/optimistic_dad is set to 1, it will be disabled otherwise.
sysctl_rel_body.router_solicitation_delay: Number of seconds to wait after interface is brought up before sending Router Solicitations. Default: 1
sysctl_rel_body.router_solicitation_interval: Number of seconds to wait between Router Solicitations. Default: 4
sysctl_rel_body.router_solicitations: Number of Router Solicitations to send until assuming no routers are present. Default: 3
sysctl_rel_body.ucast_solicit: The maximum number of unicast probes in PROBE state, when the hardware address is being reconfirmed. Defaults to 3.
